title: En l'ombre d'ung buissonnet (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, En l'ombre d'ung buissonnet. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: FlorC 2442: Josquin dez pres. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2813); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
